title: Going deeper: Stop first, explain second
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Use the voice safety needs, then teach, reconnect and preserve dignity.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: move to safety before giving the explanation
principle: Distinguish a necessary safety voice from shaming or prolonged anger.
nextSentence: Immediate danger must stop now. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can move to safety before giving the explanation.
keyLearning: Distinguish a necessary safety voice from shaming or prolonged anger.
